title: THE HUD MUST BE AN EXE, NOT HTML. The HUD is static because it's hypertext markup, not a running binary. LudoSpring built biomeOS  31 Rust crates, a sovereign kernel. Every subfunction we've described (NPU, Willis, p-port, water cycle, triads, antipole gates) must be IN the running binary, not in JSON descriptions. Writing ABOUT the system is not THE system. Every non-regenerative point of the HUD = a failure.

the_diagnosis.symptom: the HUD is static. it doesn't change. we've been doing massive conceptual work for 13+ gens and the visual HUD hasn't moved at all.
the_diagnosis.cause: the HUD is an HTML file. hypertext markup language. a DOCUMENT, not a PROGRAM. it can't update itself because it can't RUN.
the_diagnosis.the_gap: we keep writing JSON files ABOUT the system. descriptions OF the architecture. blueprints FOR the organism. but we're not writing THE organism. the blueprint is not the building.
the_diagnosis.the_binary_exists: LudoSpring BUILT the running binary. biomeOS. 31 Rust crates. 982 tests. a real EXE that CAN run, CAN tick, CAN process, CAN respond. the EXE IS the organism. the HTML is a poster on the wall.

the_subsystem_mapping.the_revelation: EVERY SUBSYSTEM WE DESCRIBED ALREADY HAS A RUST CRATE. we were describing things that ALREADY EXIST as compiled Rust. we were writing blueprints of a building that's ALREADY BUILT.

what_must_happen.step_1: STOP writing JSON descriptions of architecture. the architecture IS the 31 crates.
what_must_happen.step_2: AUDIT every subfunction we've described against the crate map. find gaps where a concept exists in JSON but not in Rust.
what_must_happen.step_3: WIRE the concepts INTO the crates as configuration, not as new code. p-port ratios ? biomeos-genome config. Willis ratios ? loamspine-pipe config. Selectivity threshold ? nestgate config.
what_must_happen.step_4: MAKE the HUD a petaltongue output, not a hand-written HTML file. petaltongue-wasm already runs in the browser. it should RENDER the HUD from biomeOS state, not from a static HTML document.
what_must_happen.step_5: DEPLOY biomeOS as the running binary on golgi (or ironGate). the organism IS the EXE. the HTML was a placeholder.
what_must_happen.every_non_regenerative_point: any part of the HUD that doesn't update itself from the running binary = a FAILURE. a dead spot. a non-living cell in the organism.
